thinking_text:
**Evaluating CAD features**

I think I might be looking at a feature target situation. For instance, I could use cad:Feature for T02, especially for all chamfer and radius features. T03 and T04 seem to involve new geometry in cad:Fillet. When it says "all radii," that likely refers to existing fillets, meaning existing chamfers and radii fall under the ontology parent cad:Feature. I need to ensure I understand how these components are interconnected!

request.raw_text: Let's make this part symmetric. There is a step on one of the sides of the whistle. Move the protruding surface so that it is level with the surface next to it. Delete all chamfers and radii and new ones following rules: Horizontal edges in the area where the narrow and bigger part of the whistle meet have a radius R=20mm. Other edges have R=5mm applied to them
action_words: make level with the surface next to it
reference_geometry_words: one of the sides of the whistle
area where the narrow and bigger part of the whistle meet

aim.primary_aim: Produce a symmetric whistle part by leveling the stepped protruding surface with its neighboring surface and replacing all existing chamfers and radii with specified 20 mm and 5 mm edge radii.

functional_design_intentions.name: Part symmetry
functional_design_intentions.description: The final whistle geometry should be symmetric, with the existing one-sided step eliminated by making the protruding surface level with the adjacent surface.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: The protruding surface forming the step on one side of the whistle

required_relationships.reference: the surface next to the protruding surface

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: All existing chamfers on the whistle part
All existing radii on the whistle part
Horizontal edges in the area where the narrow and bigger parts of the whistle meet

required_relationships.reference: the narrow and bigger parts of the whistle meet
horizontal edges in that meeting area

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: All other edges not assigned the 20 mm radius

required_relationships.reference: horizontal edges in the area where the narrow and bigger parts meet

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Non-targeted whistle geometry, including the overall narrow-part and bigger-part form
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing geometry except for the one-sided step and the complete replacement of chamfers and radii required by the request.

geometry.description: The previously protruding surface is level with the adjacent surface, eliminating the one-sided step and making the part symmetric.
No pre-existing chamfers remain on the final whistle part.
No pre-existing radii remain; final radii conform only to the replacement radius rules.
Horizontal edges in the meeting area between the narrow and bigger parts have a 20 mm radius.

relationships.reference: horizontal edges in the area where the narrow and bigger parts meet

geometry.description: All other edges have a 5 mm radius.

validation_criteria.description: The protruding surface and the adjacent surface are level, the referenced side step is absent, and the resulting part is symmetric.
No chamfer geometry remains on the final part.
No pre-existing radius geometry remains; only radii satisfying the replacement rules are present.
Every horizontal edge in the area where the narrow and bigger parts meet has the specified radius.
Every other edge not assigned the 20 mm radius has the specified radius.
The final whistle part achieves the requested geometric symmetry.
Geometry outside the leveled step region and the replaced edge treatments retains the existing overall narrow-part and bigger-part form.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not identify the protruding surface, its neighboring surface, or the intended symmetry reference by model IDs.
candidate_interpretations: The protruding surface is the surface visibly forming the one-sided step, and it should become level with its immediately adjacent surface.
Symmetry is defined by the corresponding geometry on the opposite side of the whistle.

unresolved_requirements.description: The reference frame used to classify edges as horizontal is not explicitly stated.
candidate_interpretations: Horizontal means horizontal in the model's established coordinate system.
Horizontal means horizontal relative to the whistle's principal orientation.

unresolved_requirements.description: The phrase 'other edges' may refer either to all remaining edges of the part or only to the remaining edges in the narrow-to-bigger-part meeting area.
candidate_interpretations: Apply the 5 mm radius to every edge of the part except the junction edges assigned the 20 mm radius.
Apply the 5 mm radius only to other edges in the narrow-to-bigger-part meeting area.
